name: Whirlpool WRT311 ADC Defrost Heater (W10674984)
purpose: WRT311FDZT00 wiring sheet — 350–480 W @ 120 VAC (42–30 Ω). Embraco EM3Z/EM3D platform.
failureModes: Open heater — no defrost, evaporator frost
Out of 30–42 Ω band — wrong heater or partial short
testingTips: Power off; ohm at defrost heater terminals on evaporator
Differs from W10330404 job-aid ~30 Ω — use this sheet for WRT311* ADC models

name: Whirlpool WRT311 Defrost Bi-Metal (W10674984)
purpose: Service bi-metal opens at 58°F per W10674984 — closed when evaporator cold/frosted.
failureModes: Open when frosted — heater never runs
testingTips: Test at harness with power disconnected
Closed when cold/frosted; opens at ~58°F on this platform

name: Whirlpool WRT311 ADC Defrost Heater Output (P2–P6)
purpose: ADC 2000 pin P2 (PK) to P6 (WH) — 120 VAC to defrost heater when energized (defrost or test mode).
failureModes: 0 V during forced defrost — ADC relay or wiring
120 V present but no heat — open heater or bi-metal
testingTips: Enter ADC defrost test mode (thermostat sequence) with bi-metal closed
Measure P2 (PK) to P6 (WH) at ADC connector

name: Whirlpool WRT311 ADC Cooling Output (P6–P4)
purpose: ADC 2000 P6 (WH) to P4 (OR) — 120 VAC to compressor, evap fan, and condenser fan when cooling.
failureModes: No voltage when thermostat calling — ADC or thermostat
Voltage present but compressor off — PTC, overload, or compressor
testingTips: Thermostat calling; compressor should be running or starting
Also verify P1 (BK) to P6 (WH) constant 120 VAC when plugged in

name: Whirlpool WRT311 Total Wattage @ 70°F Ambient
purpose: W10674984 performance table — total watts at 70°F ambient during normal run.
failureModes: Very low watts — compressor not pumping or off
Very high watts — high ambient, restriction, or shorted load
testingTips: Compare to 90°F (130±20 W) and 110°F (140±20 W) bands when room is hot
Pair with high/low side PSIG from same table when gauges available
